name: Kuki Ageha
source:
A rich girl who is [url=/c3794]Yume's[/url] classmate. She has a butler of her own named [url=/c3801]Kojūrō[/url] whom she often hits regardless of whether he has failed a task or done a good deed. She comes to have feelings for [url=/c3791]Ren[/url] after seeing his honest, hardworking personality.

[From [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
